protocol.adoption_rule: Adopt only a parsimonious curve that beats the deployed constant in both selection and confirmation, remains useful in the complete Python replay with the country venue layer, and passes ranking guardrails.
protocol.confirmation: One winner per family was evaluated on untouched 2020-2026 matches after temperatures were refitted through 2019.
protocol.main_network_and_venue_learning: This screen changes the main rating-network update. If a curve passes, the same curve is separately checked for the country-venue learning update before release.
protocol.selection: Candidate curves were selected only by 2010-2019 log loss after probability temperatures were fitted through 2009.
